newsitem.title: USA: Brent perks up in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent perks up in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent perked up in late U.S. paper trading on Wednesday, traders said.
A full boat of June Brent traded at $18.00, up two cents from the close of London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
Three June Brent partials switched hands, twice at $18.00 and once at $18.04
Intermonth spreads were weaker, backpeddling to Tuesday's low levels. May/June traded twice at minus 23 cents, down from trades of minus 16 and minus 15 earlier in the day.
